title: Proof architecture fan-out and cheap falsification
objective: Generate diverse proof architectures for C001, state one falsifiable bottleneck lemma per architecture, and use small-matrix tests to rank rather than prematurely merge them.
acceptance_checks: Contains genuinely different mechanisms, not wording variants.
Each idea has a minimal falsifiable lemma and failure criterion.
Known matrix AM-GM and symmetrization barriers are addressed.
Only selected branches are recommended for deep proof runs.
